profile.name: Muhammad Fachry Alfareeza
profile.headline: Software, data, and applied AI.
profile.tagline: Information Engineering student at Universitas Gadjah Mada, building things that put those to practical use.
profile.availability: Open to software, data, and applied AI work
profile.about: I study Information Engineering at Universitas Gadjah Mada and build things that use data to make a decision easier. Lately that has meant a loan-assessment agent for small businesses, flood and landslide risk maps, air-quality pipelines, and an energy dashboard. I spent a semester on a funded exchange at Kırıkkale University in Türkiye.

projects.name: WeBank-AI
projects.description: Scores small-business micro-loans from daily cash flow. An event-driven banking agent with DSCR risk scoring, HMAC privacy proofs, prompt-injection defenses, and data-purging controls. Built for FinTechathon 2026.

projects.name: InaFlews
projects.description: Maps flood and landslide risk across Uber H3 cells. A geospatial dashboard mockup for spotting high-risk locations.

projects.name: AITF_Web (Airen)
projects.description: Reviews Indonesian government TOR and RAB documents against a two-stage screening checklist. A frontend-only wireframe that consumes AI-review output from a separate system and leaves the final verdict to a human reviewer.

projects.name: AirQuality_Report
projects.description: Cleans and merges data from several weather APIs into one dataset. A Python pipeline.

projects.name: IETO-Dashboard
projects.description: Compares renewable and non-renewable generation side by side. An energy monitoring dashboard mockup.

projects.name: SolarWise
projects.description: Finds where solar panels pay off and estimates the return. A climate-action web app concept.
